WHO WE ARE

MORE THAN
A BOXING BRAND.

Round One is built around a simple idea: making boxing more accessible through personalised training and boxing equipment.

We provide private home-based and online boxing coaching alongside a growing range of boxing products, helping customers develop their skills and access the equipment they need.

Whether you're training for fitness, learning the fundamentals or continuing your boxing journey, Round One brings training and equipment together under one brand.

LOCAL BOXING TRAINING

BOXING TRAINING IN
SALISBURY HEIGHTS.

Round One offers private boxing training at our home-based training location in Salisbury Heights, South Australia. We welcome clients from surrounding northern Adelaide suburbs who want to learn boxing, improve their fitness and build confidence through personalised coaching.
